entries.reason: `IF EIBCALEN > 0` (the outer test of WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE's COMMAREA copy) is false only for a call with no COMMAREA. Before any error path the program has already used the COMMAREA: lines 99-101 MOVE CA-Request-ID(4:1), CA-Policy-Num and CA-Customer-Num (and the Evaluate's CA-* fields) into the file record, items of the LINKAGE DFHCOMMAREA, so with EIBCALEN 0 they are read from no storage. The only caller, LGAPDB01 (line 243), LINKs with Commarea(DFHCOMMAREA) LENGTH(32500), so EIBCALEN is never 0 on a call; a harness cannot state a COMMAREA-less call without a reference to unaddressable LINKAGE storage, which IBM leaves undefined (X23: a reference past EIBCALEN is refused on both sides, the task judged up to it).
